title: The full units sheaf is preserved by etale/pro-etale comparison
statement: For every scheme Z, the counit of the etale/pro-etale comparison adjunction on abelian sheaves, evaluated at the full pro-etale units sheaf, is an isomorphism. Here the adjunction is [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] and the units sheaf is [def-pur-proetale-units-sheaf].

source.place: lemma-describe-pullback-from-etale (Tag 0GLZ), with affine limit sections and descent of a unit and its inverse

proof.text: Units commute with filtered colimits of commutative rings. Descend a unit and its inverse to a common stage and descend the equation ab=1 to a later stage. This gives surjectivity; equality of units descends because equality of their underlying ring elements descends. The proof constructs the colimit comparison and uses the filtered-colimit equality criterion in Mathlib.

source.place: lemma-describe-pullback-from-etale (Tag 0GLZ), with affine limit sections and descent of a unit and its inverse

proof.text: For an affine pro-etale presentation U=lim U_i, the existing source-library theorem isColimit_comparisonUpperStar_mapCocone_of_isAffine identifies sections of the comparison inverse image with the filtered colimit of etale sections. Mathlib nonempty_isColimit_Γ_mapCocone identifies global rings of the affine limit. Apply the preceding units calculation and the lifted units functor to obtain the same colimit description for the full units sheaf.

source.place: lemma-describe-pullback-from-etale (Tag 0GLZ), with affine limit sections and descent of a unit and its inverse

proof.text: The comparison unit is invertible, hence the counit is invertible after restriction to every etale object by the triangular identities. Naturality gives a map between the two colimit cocones above. Uniqueness of colimits makes its component at U invertible. Every affine pro-etale object has such a presentation; restriction to the affine dense subsite detects isomorphisms, as implemented by isIso_of_isIso_app_affineProEt.
